Procurements exceeding $5,000 up to $100,000 are normally provided by small businesses utilizing the AOC small business set-aside program i

The design team must review compliance with the building program at each stage of the project to ensure the requirements of the program, AOC Facility Standards and relevant codes and standards have been met. General Building Standards: Quality of Architectural/Engineering Design: The designs of new facilities should not detract from those that exist presently, and designs for rehabilitation or renovation should seek to preserve the character and history of the U.S. Capitol. New materials are expected to be of similar quality as existing, adjacent, historic, monumental examples: i. Dignity: Designs shall reflect the dignity that the citizens of the United States accord their Congress. ii. Long Life: Major facilities are designed for extremely long lives. Design shall provide for flexibility to allow for future change throughout the life of the building. iii. This document contains technical criteria to be used in the programming, design, construction, measurement, verification and documentation of AOC facilities. This is a mandatory standard and is not a guidebook, textbook, handbook, training manual nor substitute for technical competence. It represents the AOC’s commitment to comply with the requirements of applicable law and widely accepted building codes and standards. This standard must be used in conjunction with the governing standards referenced in this document, as well as the building program for each project. If a conflict exists between these standards and a specific program and project requirements, contact Planning and Project Management for resolution. throughout the planning, design, construction and occupancy of the project. Commissioning Guidelines for AOC Projects are contained in the policy statement of June 7, 2010. During the initial planning process, the AOC Project Team shall determine the purpose and role of commissioning. The purpose may be to ensure proper integration of a small renovation/rehabilitation into the Capitol 7 AOC Order 28-8, December 26, 2018 complex, or it may be related to a certification. As a rule, if a project is designed by an Associate A/E, then commissioning will be performed by a third party hired by the AOC. General: The main objectives of this section are to optimize building performance and minimize adverse effects on the environment. It is the intent of this section to achieve these goals through the following measures: i. Address planning, designing and construction of new buildings and renovations or alterations to existing buildings. ii. Increase cost savings through better energy, water and material management. iii. Reduce water supply constraints and preserve a critical natural resource. iv. sla_onsite.text: onID="2.0.2">CRITERION.EXCLUSION.CONVICTIONS.PARTICIPATION_IN_CRIMINAL_ORGANISATION</cbc:CriterionTypeCode> <cbc:Name>Osalemine kuritegelikus organisatsioonis</cbc:Name> <cbc:Description languageID="ET">Kas ettevõtja ise või tema haldus-, juht- või järelevalveorgani liige või isik, kellel on volitused seda ettevõtjat esindada, tema nimel otsuseid teha või teda kontrollida, on lõpliku süüdimõistva kohtuotsusega süüdi mõistetud kuritegelikus organisatsioonis osalemise eest kõige rohkem viimase viie aasta jooksul või kehtib süüdimõistvas kohtuotsuses sätestatud kõrvalejäämise kohustus endiselt?</cbc:Description> <cac:Legislation> <cbc:ID schemeID="CriteriaTaxonomy" schemeAgencyID="EU-COM-GROW" schemeVersionID="2.0.2">c753a2c5-59e6-4970-b6eb-27224e96bf76</cbc:ID> <cbc:Title languageID="ET">RHS § 95 lg 1 p 1 "keda või kelle haldus-, juhtimis- või järelevalveorgani liiget, prokuristi või muud isikut, kellel on volitus seda ettevõtjat esindada, tema nimel otsuseid teha või teda kontrollida, on karistatud kuritegelikus ühenduses osalemise eest". Kui hankemenetlusest kõrvaldamise alus esineb, võib ettevõtja soovi korral esitada tõendeid selle kohta, et ta on võtnud meetmeid oma usaldusväärsuse taastamiseks. Heastamise võimalus on ettevõtjal juh

esindada, tema nimel otsuseid teha või teda kontrollida, on karistatud kuritegelikus ühenduses osalemise eest". Kui hankemenetlusest kõrvaldamise alus esineb, võib ettevõtja soovi korral esitada tõendeid selle kohta, et ta on võtnud meetmeid oma usaldusväärsuse taastamiseks. Heastamise võimalus on ettevõtjal juhul, kui tegemist on rahvusvahelist piirmäära ületava hankega või hankija on selle hanke alusdokumentides ette näinud.</cbc:Description> <cac:Language> <cbc:LocaleCode listID="LanguageCodeEU" listAgencyName="EU-COM-GROW" listVersionID="2.0.2">ET</cbc:LocaleCode> </cac:Language> </cac:Legislation> <cac:TenderingCriterionPropertyGroup> <cbc:ID schemeID="CriteriaTaxonomy" schemeAgencyID="EU-COM-GROW" schemeVersionID="2.0.2">7c637c0c-7703-4389-ba52-02997a055bd7</cbc:ID> <cbc:PropertyGroupTypeCode listID="PropertyGroupType" listAgencyID="EU-COM-GROW" listVersionID="2.0.2">ON*</cbc:PropertyGroupTypeCode> <cac:TenderingCriterionProperty> <cbc:ID schemeID="CriteriaTaxonomy" schemeAgencyID="EU-COM-GROW" schemeVersionID="2.0.2">8a42266c5fb24e32ff421942459d66ac-1.1</cbc:ID> <cbc:Description languageID="ET">Mis on Teie vastus?</cbc:Description> <cbc:

See kõrvalejätmise alus hõlmab ka korruptsiooni avaliku sektori hankija (võrgustiku sektori hankija) või ettevõtja riigi õiguses sätestatud määratluses.</cbc:Description> <cac:Legislation> <cbc:ID schemeID="CriteriaTaxonomy" schemeAgencyID="EU-COM-GROW" schemeVersionID="2.0.2">c753a2c5-59e6-4970-b6eb-27224e96bf76</cbc:ID> <cbc:Title languageID="ET">RHS § 95 lg 1 p 1 ja lg 2 "keda või kelle haldus-, juhtimis- või järelevalveorgani liiget, prokuristi või muud isikut, kellel on volitus seda ettevõtjat esindada, tema nimel otsuseid teha või teda kontrollida, on karistatud aususe kohustuse rikkumise või korruptiivse teo eest". Kui hankemenetlusest kõrvaldamise alus esineb, võib ettevõtja soovi korral esitada tõendeid selle kohta, et ta on võtnud meetmeid oma usaldusväärsuse taastamiseks. Heastamise võim

a nimel otsuseid teha või teda kontrollida, on karistatud aususe kohustuse rikkumise või korruptiivse teo eest". Kui hankemenetlusest kõrvaldamise alus esineb, võib ettevõtja soovi korral esitada tõendeid selle kohta, et ta on võtnud meetmeid oma usaldusväärsuse taastamiseks. Introduction The Administrative Office of the United States Courts (AO) is seeking contractor services for the printing and mailing of the following Internal Revenue Service (IRS) information returns: • W-2, Wage and Tax Statement • 1099-R, Distributions from Pensions, Annuities, Retirement or Profit-Sharing Plans, IRAs, Insurance Contracts, etc. • 1099-INT, Interest Income • 1099-MISC, Miscellaneous Income • 1099-NEC Nonemployee Compensation The printing and mailing support service will allow the Federal Judiciary to accomplish the requirement on the annual IRS tax reporting obligations. This contract will be for printing and mailing services ONLY and DOES NOT include the contractor providing any other tax-related services. The AO will provide ready-to-print and mail Portable Document File (PDF) data files to the contractor with all W-2 and 1099 boxes prepopulated with the appropriate tax information along with appropriate instructions of each tax form. The contrac

nited States (OCONUS), as well as to U.S. territories and USCA27R0019 - Page 10 of 29 international addresses as provided by the judiciary. The contractor shall provide the judiciary with electronic copies of all W-2s and 1099s printed and mailed to the recipients. The contractor must have the capability to securely receive and store electronic files from the AO using AO approved encryption methods such as Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP) for files in-transit and hard disk encryption for files at-rest. consisting of the following: Technical Solution Brief — Maximum Five Pages The Technical Solution Brief must: Address each of the four technical focus areas in Section 2.2; Describe the proposed commercial solution, technical approach, implementation methodology, and relevant team experience; Explain the vendor’s approach to sustaining legacy operations while modernizing the DxP environment; Identify the extent to which each major capability is commercially available and immediately deployable, or instead requires conﬁguration, integration, testing, demonstration, or modiﬁcation; Describe the vendor’s approach to DevSecOps, automated quality assurance, Agile delivery, dependency management, and multi-vendor coordination; and Identify material assumptions, Government dependencies, technical risks, and decisions required from the Government. Attachment 1, Draft SOO Crosswalk — Maximum Two Pages The vendor must provide a concise crosswalk to Attachment 1, Draft SOO. The crosswalk must summarize how the proposed solution addresses the principal Draft SOO objectives, functional areas, and performance objectives. the following: technical feasibility, commercial maturity, operational risk, and alignment with the desired outcomes and technical focus areas identiﬁed in this AOI. Pages exceeding the applicable maximum will not be evaluated. Offerors are cautioned that required information included only on excluded pages will not be considered and may result in a No-Go rating. LE: files/Attach_1_-_Blood_Transfusion_Services_SOW.pdf ===== Statement of Work For Transfusion Services 20 October 2026 I. Background: The 88th Medical Group Transfusion Services requires blood components and references lab transfusion testing services. The supplier shall provide blood products and reference blood transfusion services (testing) to support the blood supply in case of emergency situations and inpatient and outpatient care at the WPAFB Medical Center when requested for a period of 5 years at the prices in the approved price list. II. Minimum Technical Requirements: The supplier shall provide blood products and reference transfusion testing that are time dependent with immediate response and expedience to treat critical patients. The supplier must operate 24/7 as the 88th Medical Group (MDG) is a 24/7 operation; this service must be available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including holidays and weekends. The supplier shall provide rapid shipment of blood products when the 88 MDG Transfusion Services in-house inventory is in need to support critical patients. The one-hour turnaround time for testing is a mission-critical requirement. The blood supplier shall deliver routine blood products ordered on a STAT basis within one (1) hour of the blood sup

eipt of an emergent request for blood products. The required completion point is delivery to the Transfusion Services department. The supplier must fulfill our request with the ordered product with appropriate compatible blood type, applicable testing, and requested quantities. Any unforeseen delays are understandable; however, the ultimate goal is for the delivering agency to aim for the <1 hour delivery time. An appropriate transmittal list is required with each delivery. If emergent requests are unable to be consistently met, it could mean critical failure for our hospital's life-saving capabilities. The supplier shall have 24/7 reference laboratory testing capabilities for patients anticipating transfusions or medical treatment. The supplier must be licensed by the Food & Drug Administration (FDA) and follow American Association of Blood Bank (AABB) standards. The supplier must notify the 88th MDG Transfusion Services of all unexpected/abnormal tests from blood products supplied by them. The supplier shall provide look-back notifications to the 88th MDG as required by 21 CFR 610.48 (b)(3): (a) within three (3) calendar days if blood collected from a donor who tested negative at the time of donation but tests reactive for evidence of HIV or HCV infection on a later do
